events.summary: Varchild and Darien exchange missives over the carrier pigeons.
events.quote: "Birds know no borders! Why, then, should we?"

events.summary: King Darien calls every able sword to Kjeldor's side.
events.quote: "Call every able sword to our side. Kjeldor will stand triumphant!"

events.summary: The first caravan passes safely through the Karplusan Mountains, forging a trade route to Balduvia.
events.quote: "The first caravan has passed safely through the Karplusan Mountains without incident, forging a trade route to Balduvia.

events.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes says Balduvia willingly trades with Kjeldor.
events.quote: "We willingly trade with Kjeldor, but the peace we build must come from both our lands."

events.summary: Darien notes Kjeldor aided the Balduvians before and will again.
events.quote: "We aided the Balduvians once before. They need but ask and we shall do so again."

events.summary: Varchild vows her truth is stronger than their swords.
events.quote: "Let them send their legions! I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords."

events.summary: Darien urges healing the rift between Balduvia and Kjeldor.
events.quote: "Just as an Herbalist heals a wound, so must we heal the rift between Balduvia and Kjeldor."

events.summary: Halvor Arensson laments that nothing grows in Kjeldor but seaweed.
events.quote: "It's not so easy anymore. Nothing grows in Kjeldor but seaweed."

events.summary: Darien laments missing dead turning up in Varchild's ranks.
events.quote: "Far too many of our missing 'dead' seem to be turning up in Varchild's ranks!"

events.summary: Rising oceans bring new lakes and terrors to Terisiare and the Viscerids spawn everywhere.
events.quote: The rising oceans brought new lakes—and new terrors—to Terisiare.

events.summary: Atlantis charges Explorers to track the Viscerids.
events.quote: Distant Atlantis charged these Explorers with the task of venturing into unknown waters to track the despised Viscerids.

events.summary: Gerda Äagesdotter says Lat-Nam's knowledge could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War.
events.quote: "All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."

events.summary: Arcum Dagsson laments Soldev crushed by his machines.
events.quote: "It cannot be! Soldev crushed, and my machines to blame?"

events.summary: Dagsson says machines' betrayal broke his heart.
events.quote: "Nothing has ever broken my heart so much as this—the betrayal of Soldev by my beloved machines!"

events.summary: Sorine Relicbane warns of dark deeds in Soldev.
events.quote: "Rumors persist of dark deeds performed in the depths of Soldev. When will Dagsson heed the danger therein?"

events.summary: Sorine says Dagsson ignored Phyrexia's lessons in building a mechanical utopia.
events.quote: "Dagsson should have paid attention to the lessons of Phyrexia before attempting to create a mechanical utopia."

events.summary: Chaeska declares service to Lim-Dûl continues.
events.quote: "Whether whole or not, still we serve Lim-Dûl's wishes."

events.summary: Chaeska says the High Guard stands while Tresserhorn stands.
events.quote: "Death does not prevent us from service to our absent master. As long as Tresserhorn stands, so shall we."

events.summary: Halvor Arensson says Lim-Dûl's terrors remain.
events.quote: "We are not yet free of Lim-Dûl's terrors."

events.summary: Kolbjörn mourns Disa and vows to stop the pestilence.
events.quote: "Disa is dead, and I am left. I shall allow no others to succumb to this pestilence."

events.summary: A priest reports the plague infests Krov worst.
events.quote: "My lord, there is only so much I can do. This plague infests Krov worse than any other city."

events.summary: Lovisa says the Order of Stromgald spreads lies within Varchild's troops.
events.quote: "The Order of Stromgald spreads its poisonous lies from within Varchild's troops, and still she sees only visions of conquest."

events.summary: Varchild dismisses the Order of Stromgald as lost.
events.quote: "The 'fabled' Order of Stromgald is cast to the four winds, lost for all time. I, for one, give them no thought."

events.summary: Lovisa declares peace only when Varchild's head is taken.
events.quote: "Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head."

events.summary: Darien says Varchild's soldiers need Goblin knowledge of their mountain home.
events.quote: "Her soldiers' hatred for the Goblins is tempered only by their need for what the Goblins alone hold: knowledge of their mountain home."

events.summary: Varchild calls for Balduvia to burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth.
events.quote: "Let Balduvia burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth!"

events.summary: Darien says Varchild would draw maps of Kjeldor in Balduvian blood.
events.quote: "We could have peace, but Varchild would rather have the maps of the new Kjeldor drawn in Balduvian blood."

events.summary: Kaysa speaks as Elder Druid but Yavimaya recognizes only its own voice.
events.quote: Kaysa speaks as the Elder Druid, but the Yavimaya recognizes only one voice: its own.

events.summary: Taaveti says the Fyndhorn orphans find no welcome in Yavimaya.
events.quote: "We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."

events.summary: Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources is recalled.
events.quote: Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.

events.summary: The School of the Unseen hides after retribution on Lat-Nam.
events.quote: After the terrible retribution visited upon Lat-Nam, this school of mages chose to hide from the eyes of the world.
